subject: PO requirements and invoice cadence for enterprise pricing
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orchidhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: PO requirements + invoice cadence for Redwood contract

Hi Markus / Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Orchid is ready to move forward but procurement has a few requirements we need confirmed before issuing a PO. High-level: 
- We need Redwood to accept a formal PO referencing multiple cost centers (we'll supply a single PO with lines mapped to different BU codes).
- Net terms: our standard is net60. Please confirm if Redwood can accept net60 for enterprise deals and whether a credit application is required.
- Invoice cadence: we prefer a monthly consolidated invoice at the parent-company level, with line-level details for each cost center. Occasionally AP will request weekly statements for reconciliation — is that possible?
- PO must include remit-to, TAX ID/EIN, and Redwood invoice email for AP.

I've attached our procurement doc that lists the fields our ERP needs (Orchid_PO_Requirements.docx). If you can confirm what you need on your side (PO fields + any required legal verbiage) we'll route PO to AP.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Senior Procurement Manager
Orchid Health
elena.soto@orchidhealth.com

Attachment: Orchid_PO_Requirements.docx (docx)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-30T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoice cadence for Redwood contract

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the doc. Quick answers below and next steps.

Summary answers:
- PO fields: we can accept a single PO that maps multiple cost-center lines. Required PO fields we need are: PO number, billing entity name, remit-to address (Redwood Billing), Redwood TAX ID (EIN: 54-3219876), and a contact email for AP.
- Net terms: standard for our self-serve/SMB customers is net30. For enterprise agreements we can offer net60, but that requires a completed credit application and finance approval (usually a 5–7 business day review).
- Invoice cadence: we support monthly consolidated invoices at the parent level with line-level details. We can also provide weekly statement exports for reconciliation; weekly invoice runs are uncommon but we can provide a statement feed (CSV) at no extra cost for enterprise customers.
- Discounts / packaging: the discount bands are applied based on committed monthly usage (or annual committed spend). For example, a 12-month commitment at the mid-tier qualifies for a 12% Platform discount + waived overage for caching layer. 

I've attached our PartnerPricing_Sheet_v2.xlsx that lists the required PO fields, sample line-item mapping, and the discount band thresholds. For net60 we'll need the credit app completed (link in my signature) and the PO + signed order to finalize pricing.

Next steps I propose:
1) Can you confirm which legal entity will sign and the parent company billing entity?
2) If net60 is required, please complete the credit app at: https://redwood.ai/credit-app/ORCH-2027 and let us know the expected payment method (ACH / Wire).
3) Send the PO to billing@redwood.ai once fields are populated; cc me and Vanessa so we can expedite finance review.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through mapping cost centers into the PO lines — I can bring Vanessa (AP specialist) and Grace from finance if useful.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0162

Attachment: PartnerPricing_Sheet_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Tom Blanchard <tom.blanchard@orchidhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orchidhealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-30T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoice cadence for Redwood contract

Markus — thanks for the quick summary. A few clarifications from Orchid AP below (I'm forwarding to Grace to loop finance early):

- Entity mapping: Orchid will issue a single PO to Redwood that includes multiple line items tagged with our internal cost-center codes (we'll attach a mapping file). That PO must be accepted as-is; our ERP will not accept splits into separate invoices per cost center.
- Net60 is non-negotiable for our central AP operations unless otherwise approved by our CFO. We will complete a credit application if you provide the link.
- Invoice cadence: our operating model requires a monthly consolidated invoice with separate sub-lines per cost center. However, for reconciliation we sometimes request a weekly statement CSV (not a separate invoice) that shows daily usage and line attribution.

Can Redwood confirm that: (a) you will accept a single PO with multiple cost center lines, (b) you can deliver a monthly consolidated invoice that lists each cost center on the invoice, and (c) you can provide a weekly reconciliation CSV feed?

If finance needs a formal SOW clause or order language to support the PO acceptance, we can include standard verbiage — let us know what specific wording you require.

Thanks,
Tom Blanchard
Director, AP & Vendor Mgmt
Orchid Health
Attachment: cost_center_mapping.csv (csv)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Blanchard <tom.blanchard@orchidhealth.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-31T15:45:00Z
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoice cadence for Redwood contract

Hi Tom / Elena — looping in final finance guidance and the acceptance path.

Finance position (concise):
- We can accept a single PO with multiple cost center lines and will issue a monthly consolidated invoice to the parent company showing line-level detail. Please ensure each line in the PO contains: cost_center_code, line description, quantity/units, unit price, and total.
- Net60: available for enterprise deals after a completed credit application and standard KYC. Once the credit app is approved we will update terms to net60 in our billing system. Typical review window is 3–7 business days after submission.
- Weekly reconciliation: we can provide a weekly CSV statement export for reconciliation (it is not treated as an invoice). We will expose this as a secure S3 drop or an emailed CSV to your AP contact depending on your security preferences.

Required steps to finalize:
1) Orchid to submit completed PO (with cost-center mapping) to billing@redwood.ai and cc finance@redwood.ai.
2) Orchid to complete the credit application here: https://redwood.ai/credit-app/ORCH-2027. Please include a contact name and phone for references.
3) Redwood will respond within 5 business days with net-term confirmation and apply any pre-agreed discount once the signed order + PO are present in our system.

Suggested SOW language for acceptance (if you want to include it in your PO):
"Redwood Inference will accept a consolidated purchase order referencing multiple internal cost centers provided the PO includes line-level cost center codes, unit pricing, and a single parent billing entity. Invoices will be issued monthly to the parent billing entity with line-level detail mapped to the referenced cost center codes."

I'll attach a brief PO submission checklist that our billing team uses to avoid back-and-forth. If Orchid can send the PO today we'll start the credit review immediately and aim to turn terms within the week.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
